wrapperContract.ownership: Each Create or CreateEncoded result owns one SafeHandle and its outgoing managed connections. FnGraphNode copies share that state without cloning nodes or duplicating native references. FnGraph does not retain created nodes.
wrapperContract.configuration: Create and connect the complete acyclic graph before sampling. Exact metadata, ownership, and cycle checks occur only during cold graph mutation.
wrapperContract.hybridReplacement: A node-backed hybrid may replace another node. FastNoise2 1.1.1 cannot detach it, so the wrapper rejects a later constant assignment. Constant mutation is also rejected on an encoded root because its existing connection state is opaque.
wrapperContract.sampling: Batch sampling is managed-allocation-free and does not validate graph state. It retains only constant-time span bounds and overlap checks that protect native memory.
wrapperContract.batchMinMax: FastNoise2 1.1.1 computes batch minimum and maximum internally on every batch call. Omitting the managed outputMinMax span avoids only copying those two values.
wrapperContract.nodeLifetime: SafeHandle finalizers call DeleteNodeRef when a node is no longer retained by callers or connected roots, even while FnGraph remains alive. Replacing a connection releases its old managed dependency unless it is still shared. Stop workers and drop owned roots and node caches on unload; cleanup occurs during GC. Nodes and FnGraph have no Clear or Dispose API.
wrapperContract.nativeMemory: Nodes use intrusive native references and 64 KiB pooled allocations by default; the pool is shared, not allocated once per node. Pool-size tuning is absent from the C ABI.
wrapperContract.encodedTrees: CreateEncoded loads a complete version-coupled Base64 tree and exposes only its root. The binding cannot export trees or inspect the decoded root's existing connections.
wrapperContract.numericBounds: FastNoise metadata minimums and maximums are editor guidance and native setters do not generally enforce them.
wrapperContract.enumOrdinals: Except FnFeatureSet, managed enum integers are wrapper details, not native metadata IDs, native option indexes, or stable serialization values.

knownUpstreamBehavior.name: Hybrid detachment
knownUpstreamBehavior.behavior: FastNoise_C.h says a null node detaches a hybrid, but the 1.1.1 implementation rejects null and an active node continues to override its stored constant.
knownUpstreamBehavior.managedResponse: FnGraph tracks wrapper-created connections and rejects misleading float replacement; encoded-root float mutation is rejected because connection state is opaque.

knownUpstreamBehavior.name: Null node deletion
knownUpstreamBehavior.behavior: FastNoise_C.h describes fnDeleteNodeRef(NULL) as a no-op, but the 1.1.1 implementation dereferences the pointer.
knownUpstreamBehavior.managedResponse: FnNodeHandle never invokes DeleteNodeRef for an invalid handle.

knownUpstreamBehavior.name: Incomplete required sources
knownUpstreamBehavior.behavior: Generation assumes every required source has been connected and can assert or dereference null for an incomplete graph.
knownUpstreamBehavior.managedResponse: Documentation requires complete graph construction; hot sampling deliberately performs no graph traversal.

knownUpstreamBehavior.name: DistanceToPoint default
knownUpstreamBehavior.behavior: The constructed 1.1.1 C++ node uses Euclidean Squared although runtime metadata advertises Euclidean.
knownUpstreamBehavior.managedResponse: Configure DistanceFunction explicitly when the distinction matters.

knownUpstreamBehavior.name: Metadata numeric bounds
knownUpstreamBehavior.behavior: Metadata minimum and maximum values are Node Editor hints and most native setters do not enforce them.
knownUpstreamBehavior.managedResponse: The wrapper forwards numeric values without hot or cold policy clamping.

knownUpstreamBehavior.name: Batch minimum and maximum
knownUpstreamBehavior.behavior: The pinned native build calculates a range for every batch even when the C caller supplies no range pointer.
knownUpstreamBehavior.managedResponse: The range overload exposes the already-computed values; omitting it saves only the two-float copy.

knownUpstreamBehavior.name: Raw grid count multiplication
knownUpstreamBehavior.behavior: The C implementation multiplies signed 32-bit grid dimensions before forwarding the sample count.
knownUpstreamBehavior.managedResponse: The wrapper requires positive dimensions and verifies their product fits Int32 before the native call.

knownUpstreamBehavior.name: Domain-warp Seed Offset
knownUpstreamBehavior.behavior: In 1.1.1 direct Simplex and Gradient warps apply Seed Offset twice, direct SuperSimplex applies it once, and fractal warp use applies it once for Simplex/Gradient but not for SuperSimplex.
knownUpstreamBehavior.managedResponse: The wrapper preserves upstream output exactly; leave warp Seed Offset at zero unless this version-specific behavior is intentional.

knownUpstreamBehavior.name: PowInt low exponents
knownUpstreamBehavior.behavior: The 1.1.1 implementation squares the input when Pow is less than 2 instead of producing identity or reciprocal behavior.
knownUpstreamBehavior.managedResponse: Use integer powers of 2 or greater.

nodes.name: Constant
nodes.purpose: Uniform scalar source for masks, operands, and hybrid-equivalent wiring.

nodes.name: White
nodes.purpose: Independent seeded values without spatial continuity.

nodes.name: Checkerboard
nodes.purpose: Alternates the configured output bounds by N-dimensional cell parity.

nodes.name: SineWave
nodes.purpose: Product of sin(coordinate / Feature Scale) across active axes; each axis has period 2*pi*Feature Scale.

nodes.name: Gradient
nodes.purpose: Linear coordinate field assembled independently from X, Y, Z, and W.

nodes.name: DistanceToPoint
nodes.purpose: Distance field from a configurable point in the current, possibly modified domain.

nodes.name: Simplex
nodes.purpose: Recommended general coherent source with good speed, smoothness, and isotropy.

nodes.name: SuperSimplex
nodes.purpose: Extra-smooth, highly isotropic coherent source at greater cost than Simplex.

nodes.name: Perlin
nodes.purpose: Classic grid-gradient coherent noise with characteristic directional structure.

nodes.name: Value
nodes.purpose: Seeded pseudorandom lattice values blended with Hermite interpolation; not gradient noise.

nodes.name: CellularValue
nodes.purpose: White-noise value associated with the selected cellular distance rank.

nodes.name: CellularDistance
nodes.purpose: Remapped distance rank or combination of two selected ranks; Index0Sub1 is an absolute difference.

nodes.name: CellularLookup
nodes.purpose: Evaluates a required source at the closest jittered cell position with the incoming seed plus one.

nodes.name: FractalFBm
nodes.purpose: Unnormalized sum of source octaves for terrain, clouds, and organic textures.

nodes.name: PingPong
nodes.purpose: Folds Source * Ping Pong Strength into a triangular waveform in [0,1].

nodes.name: FractalRidged
nodes.purpose: Unnormalized sum of 1 - 2*abs(Source) octaves for ridges and canyons.

nodes.name: DomainWarpSimplex
nodes.purpose: High-quality simplex coordinate distortion with configurable vector construction.

nodes.name: DomainWarpSuperSimplex
nodes.purpose: Smoothest built-in coordinate warp, at higher cost than simplex warp.

nodes.name: DomainWarpGradient
nodes.purpose: Fast gradient-grid coordinate distortion.

nodes.name: DomainWarpFractalProgressive
nodes.purpose: Multi-octave warp in which every octave receives the previously warped position.

nodes.name: DomainWarpFractalIndependent
nodes.purpose: Multi-octave warp whose octave offsets independently accumulate from the original position.

nodes.name: Add
nodes.purpose: Adds a required field to a constant or spatially varying right operand.

nodes.name: Subtract
nodes.purpose: Subtracts two constant or spatially varying hybrid operands.

nodes.name: Multiply
nodes.purpose: Multiplies a required field by a constant or spatially varying mask.

nodes.name: Divide
nodes.purpose: Divides one hybrid operand by another; the denominator must stay away from zero.

nodes.name: Abs
nodes.purpose: Absolute magnitude of a required source.

nodes.name: Min
nodes.purpose: Hard minimum between a required field and a hybrid operand.

nodes.name: Max
nodes.purpose: Hard maximum between a required field and a hybrid operand.

nodes.name: MinSmooth
nodes.purpose: Polynomial smooth minimum for softly joining scalar fields.

nodes.name: MaxSmooth
nodes.purpose: Polynomial smooth maximum for softly joining scalar fields.

nodes.name: SignedSquareRoot
nodes.purpose: Compresses source magnitude with a square root while preserving sign.

nodes.name: PowFloat
nodes.purpose: Computes pow(max(abs(Value), FLT_MIN), Pow), discarding sign and making zero inexact.

nodes.name: PowInt
nodes.purpose: Fast integer power of a required source.

nodes.name: DomainScale
nodes.purpose: Uniform coordinate scaling before a required source.

nodes.name: DomainOffset
nodes.purpose: Constant or spatially varying per-axis coordinate translation.

nodes.name: DomainRotate
nodes.purpose: Roll rotates X, pitch Y, and yaw Z in 2D/3D; four-dimensional input passes through unrotated.

nodes.name: DomainAxisScale
nodes.purpose: Independent X, Y, Z, and W coordinate scaling for anisotropic features.

nodes.name: SeedOffset
nodes.purpose: Offsets the seed passed into a complete child graph.

nodes.name: ConvertRGBA8
nodes.purpose: Packs clamped grayscale bytes and alpha 255 into the bit pattern of each output float.

nodes.name: GeneratorCache
nodes.purpose: Caches only the most recent SIMD batch per thread for identical source, coordinates, and seed.

nodes.name: Fade
nodes.purpose: Interpolates between required A and B fields with a ranged fade signal and selectable easing.

nodes.name: Remap
nodes.purpose: Maps a required source between hybrid ranges with optional output clamping.

nodes.name: Terrace
nodes.purpose: Quantizes a source into steps with optional spatially varying transition smoothing.

nodes.name: AddDimension
nodes.purpose: Appends a hybrid final coordinate to 2D or 3D input; four-dimensional input passes through.

nodes.name: RemoveDimension
nodes.purpose: Drops a selected coordinate from 3D or 4D input; two-dimensional input passes through.

nodes.name: Modulus
nodes.purpose: Floating-point remainder of two hybrid operands; the divisor must stay away from zero.

nodes.name: DomainRotatePlane
nodes.purpose: Preset 3D rotation; 2D always promotes with XY mode, and 4D passes W through unchanged.

recipes.name: Natural height field
recipes.use: Broad terrain and organic scalar fields.

recipes.name: Biome blend
recipes.use: Spatially varying interpolation between complete graphs.

recipes.name: Animated slice
recipes.use: Time-varying 2D output without translating the XY domain.
